content:
I, as well as @Tristan Figueroa-Reid, are working on formalizing current literature on combinatorial game theory, a branch of mathematics closely related to combinatorics and algorithms.

This project is mostly working on formalizing ONAG (for algebraic properties of games) and Aaron Siegel's Combinatorial Game Theory. A side-goal of this project is to have a library of specific games and their analyses: currently, there is Domineering, general Poset games, and Nim, but we would absolutely accept more!

This new codebase builds off previous work that was done in Mathlib by many authors, including but not limited to Kim Morrison, Mario Carneiro, Junyan Xu, Yuyang Zhao, and Theodore Hwa.

This project is on GitHub at vihdzp/combinatorial-games, and we are looking for contributors. If you are interested, feel free to contact us, or talk in the linked thread.
